body:
Resolved so far: the reviewed development landings and source commits are recorded in [the v0.15.0 issue reconciliation](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/8d7a5e55914e700c69ae1a195f96cc2282b6ce64/slurm_logs/release_landing_2026-10-14/RELEASE_ISSUES.org) (PR #998). This issue remains open for the scope below.

The crop/food declared-unit asymmetry is now documented and pinned by a regression. harvest_kg_factors intentionally remains blind to declared unit_kg; food uses it.

Remaining: decide whether crop conversion should consume u_kg. If yes, re-express Ethiopia's external shipped-quintal check in the same change so it cannot become a tautology. No new factor behavior was adopted in this documentation increment.

comments.body:
**Ruling (@ligon, 2026-10-18)**, from the framework-backlog decision sheet: Yes. `harvest_kg_factors` reads the declared `u_kg` (where a country ships a conversion table, use it). In the same PR, re-express `tests/test_ethiopia_shipped_factors.py`'s quintal check against an external answer key.

Scheduled for the overnight 2026-10-18 sweep.
